profile.headline: Senior WordPress Developer & .NET Engineer | Custom Themes, Plugins, WooCommerce, REST APIs, AEM | 15+ Years | Open to FTE Roles & Consulting Engagements
profile.summary:
Web developer with 15+ years building and running enterprise web platforms — WordPress, .NET/C#, and Adobe Experience Manager.

I split my time between full-time engineering roles and independent consulting through CloverPressCMS, my own practice since 2013. Both are real, substantial work — not one moonlighting as the other.

What I do:
• Custom WordPress themes and plugins, WooCommerce, Gutenberg/block editor, headless/REST
• .NET/C# application development and SQL Server-backed systems
• AEM component and front-end development
• REST API integration, CMS governance, and long-term platform maintenance

I own projects end to end — build through production support. Clients include PatientPoint, TeamDynamix, Learning A-Z, and Thirty-One Gifts (in-house).

Open to full-time roles and new consulting engagements. If you need someone who can build it and keep it running, let's talk.

positions.title: Software Developer (.NET / Web)
positions.description:
• Build and support enterprise web and internal business applications in C#/ASP.NET for a national electronics retailer
• Implement and consume REST services against SQL Server-backed systems
• Diagnose and restore failed production applications; document root cause and fix
• Work in Agile teams with program managers and business analysts

positions.title: WordPress Developer / Platform Architect
positions.description:
• Build custom WordPress themes and plugins for government, healthcare, SaaS, and retail clients (PatientPoint, TeamDynamix, Learning A-Z, UMCF)
• Deliver WooCommerce, headless/REST, and multisite implementations end to end
• Hold long-term maintenance retainers covering security, upgrades, and performance across 6 active client sites
• 35+ WordPress builds and platform engagements delivered since 2013, across government, healthcare, SaaS, and retail

positions.title: Senior Digital Platform Lead
positions.description:
• Owned the WordPress platform and frontend architecture for a national retail brand
• Led UX and frontend modernization across the brand's web properties
• Ran CMS governance, content workflows, and the release process
• Improved accessibility and performance across enterprise properties

positions.title: Early Career: Digital Marketing & Communication
positions.description: Held progressive roles in digital marketing, communications, and web strategy across media, municipal, and corporate environments. Developed foundational experience in web platforms, content systems, and cross-functional collaboration that informed later enterprise platform leadership roles.
